clips.title: The story
paras: Above Ratchet, warlocks face the rite that binds a felhunter to their will. Strahad Farsan oversees the summoning with the restored Tome of the Cabal, drawing an aggressive demon from the Nether to be subdued in combat.

On Kalimdor's bluffs above Ratchet, the goblin port, Strahad Farsan conducts dangerous trials in demon summoning. After a warlock gathers the fragments and reagents needed to restore the ancient Tome of the Cabal, Strahad prepares the binding grounds. He lays an inner glyph of containment while his acolytes channel power through enchanted rods to complete the outer circle. The circles keep whatever emerges isolated from the settlement below.

The Tome of the Cabal holds the incantations that open a bridge into the Twisting Nether. Felhunters are ravenous demonic hounds that hunger for arcane power and feast on magical energy. No gentle enthrallment or persuasion will bind one. The warlock must violently subdue and break the summoned beast in combat before it recognizes its rightful master. Surviving the clash proves the summoner can wield the hound against enemy spellcasters.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If you're are sufficiently prepared, then we should begin. Let me explain the process to you.
I will begin by creating the basic summoning circle. When that is finished, my acolytes will use the rods of channeling to create the greater circle.

Once that is done, read the incantation from the Tome of the Cabal, and the felhunter will be pulled forth. Be careful, friend. A felhunter is a powerful foe, and I'd like to see you keep your head on your shoulders.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Every warlock should have a felhunter at his command. Though it be difficult to tame, the powers it brings to its master far outweigh the cost.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I must say I'm impressed, friend. When I faced down my felhunter, I barely escaped with my life. I sense that you have the potential to become one of the most powerful warlocks of this era.
